# Frozen release regression

Byte-preserved source from the interrupted Flockshot evaluation run. The original
evaluation project is not modified. provenance.json records hashes. This fixture
is distinct from the earlier flockshot fixture.

The six original tests pass. Independent qualification checks show the unsupported
beam geometry; the browser countercheck observes a flying bird while sling bands
still follow it. Calibration constructs a scoped control in a temporary directory,
changing only first-structure contact and band release. This is public regression
material, not a held-out model evaluation.
